notes.title: Demo Release
notes.content:
[h1]🌱 Another Update: The Demo Is Here 🌱[/h1]

[h2]Hello, Valued Community,[/h2]

Big news: the demo is ready to float into the world. After countless tweaks, fixes, and late-night coding marathons, the game has finally reached the point where you will get to experience it firsthand.

[h2]✨ What’s in the Demo?[/h2]

[h3]Playable Levels[/h3]
New areas to drift through are included. They are not perfect, but at least the seed is slightly less likely to phase through the floor and discover the underworld.

[h3]Readable Lore[/h3]
The text system has been rebuilt (again) and now includes a dyslexia-friendly font option. Words should behave themselves this time instead of wiggling around like they are possessed.

[h3]Improved Physics[/h3]
Seeds float like seeds, not bricks. Wind feels like wind, not a chaotic gale auditioning for a disaster movie.

[h3]A Tutorial That’s… Helpful?[/h3]
The introduction has been reworked so new players can actually learn how to play instead of accidentally inventing new speedrunning categories by crashing into walls.

[h3]A Healthier Camera[/h3]
The camera is now less dizzy and no longer behaves like it just stumbled out of a tavern.

[h3]Fewer Bugs (Probably)[/h3]

[list]
[*] The game saves properly.
[*] Textures no longer flicker like a rave.
[*] Music does not wander off to grab a coffee mid-level.
[*] Achievements actually unlock when you earn them.
[/list]

🌬️ Why This Matters

This demo is the first real chance to step into the world that has been in the works for far too long. It is about exploration, quiet storytelling, and the journey of a drifting seed (with only minimal existential crises).

Stay tuned: the demo release is right around the corner.

– Cherry

notes.title: Major Dev Update
notes.content:
[h1]Another Update - I'm still working on this thing, I swear.[/h1][p]Hello, My Valued Community,[/p][p]It’s me again. I'm delighted to introduce you to some more progress, which definitely didn't take too long to make. I’ve been staring at code so long, I think I can see the matrix. [i]blinks twice[/i] (send help, this dev cycle has cost me my remaining brain cells).[/p][p]Anyway, I actually did some stuff. So here’s the latest from the development dungeon.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]You can actually read stuff now.[/b][/h3][p]I spent about 15 hours revamping the text system. Again. But this time it was for a good cause: I've added a dyslexia-friendly font option. We want everyone to be able to enjoy the game's vague and mysterious lore, so now you can make the words behave. I also have remade the text animation and appeareing system to make it more lore friendly[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]I made more levels. Please clap.[/b][/h3][p]Yeah, so, making levels is difficult. I've been designing some new areas to float through. They're not done, obviously, but they exist. In theory.[/p][list][*][p][b]Final level:[/b] Combo of all before[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deserts: [/b]wind go nyoom[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Bug Fixes. So. Many. Bug Fixes.[/b][/h3][p]Yeah, no, there's just too many bugs to list here. I don't even care. My code is awful and I know it. It's a miracle this thing even runs. This is my first major project and I am learning a lot[/p][p]Let's just say the dandelion seed is [i]less likely[/i] to have a spontaneous existential crisis and phase through the floor now. Probably. The camera is also [i]slightly[/i] less drunk. I spent literally 32 hours just clicking on green lines. Again. Screw hitboxes. [/p][p]I'm going to list all that I have fixed since I need to feel the sense of accomplishment of doing anything:
The seed will no longer decide to become a submarine and clip through the ground.[/p][list][*][p]The wind in the mountains is now less "chaotic gale" and more "reliably breezy."[/p][/*][*][p]The music won't just randomly decide to take a coffee break anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug that made the dandelion seed look like a weird, stretched-out ghost.[/p][/*][*][p]The camera has been stabilized in tight spaces. No more motion sickness![/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer crash the game by pausing it. I see you, testers![/p][/*][*][p]Achievements should now trigger properly when you earn them.[/p][/*][*][p]The flickering textures in the meadow have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Progress will now actually save. (This one was a high priority, for obvious reasons!)[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer get permanently stuck inside rocks. You are a seed, not a geologist.[/p][/*][*][p]The game won't randomly forget your controller is plugged in anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Loading screens will now, you know, lead to the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Sound effects are now properly synced with the action on screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial is no longer skippable by just flying into a wall for three seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]The game will no longer try to set your resolution to something from the stone age.[/p][/*][*][p]UI elements now respect each other's personal space.[/p][/*][*][p]Plugging in a controller after launching the game now works as it should.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]I Reworked Things Because Yes[/b][/h3][p]Apparently, some of the core systems weren't optimal at all and caused huge frame drops. I knew about this issue for actually about 5 months, but I just put back fixing it for a while because I was too lazy to do it.[/p][list][*][p][b]Physics:[/b] The old physics were bad. The new physics are... newer. The seed should float more like a seed and less like a brick. Plus it actually works well against the wind now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support:[/b] I wrestled with the input manager for days. It now [i]should[/i] recognize your controller. No promises.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controls Changing:[/b] The menu for this was a nightmare. I rebuilt it. It might even work.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial:[/b] The old tutorial was useless. The new one is slightly more useful. It might actually teach you how to play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lore:[/b] I wrote more story. Yeah, there's a story. Shocking, isn't it?[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Also, some other stuff, I guess.[/b][/h3][p]I also tinkered with the UI, added some sound effects that I found, and thought about new achievements.[/p][p]Did I mention bug fixes?[/p][p]As always, your continued dedication and feedback are invaluable, mainly because you guys find the bugs I have no idea even exist. Come hang out on the Discord and tell me what you think.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates as I continue to breathe life into this extraordinary wind-kissed adventure that I've been working on for way too long.[/p][p]- Cherry[/p]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.7.0 - 1.7.4 NOTES
notes.content:
[h1]📢 Update 1.7.0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 Patch Notes - Closed Beta Exclusive![/h1]

[h2]Hello, My Valued Community![/h2]

I'm thrilled to introduce you to the latest update, version 1.7.4, a special treat exclusively tailored for our dedicated community. Taking your valuable feedback to heart, I've been hard at work to ensure a remarkable gaming experience. While updates 1.7.0, 1.7.1, 1.7.2, and 1.7.3 faced their share of issues, rest assured that 1.7.4 is here to shine.

[h2]What's New in Update 1.7.4:[/h2]

[olist]
[*][b] One New Level: A level intricately designed to offer a multitude of pathways. Depending on your decision, the level might be a bit more difficult due to some specially marked difficult routes, each route presenting its unique challenges.[/b]

[*] Your complete destruction of the game (I really can't call it otherwise, you have found bugs everywhere!) has led to significant discoveries. 

[list]
 [*] Wind particle tearing is now a distant memory
 [*] All wind effects boast precise hitboxes.
 [*] I've revamped the stamina regeneration caused by the red wind, upping the difficulty.
[/list]
[*][b] Navigating the enchanting snowy landscapes has been made smoother with precise hitbox adjustments. The occasional snow particle glitches are now a thing of the past, ensuring that your journey through the snowscapes matches the rest of the world around you.[/b]

[*] Minor movement-related bugs have been ironed out, giving you a more polished experience. Moreover, I've discreetly repositioned a few wind currents in select levels, improving the overall flow and enhancing the gameplay clarity.
[/olist]

[b][h2]Become a beta tester:[/h2]
If you're not already part of this journey, fear not! Sign up by dropping an email at [i][u]contact.pink.sakura.studios@gmail.com[/u][/i] or connect with me on Discord at [u][i]cherrymakesgames[/i][/u].[/b]

Your input has been invaluable in shaping On The Wind's Breath, and it's my honor to have you alongside me on this journey. Stay tuned for more updates, as we continue to breathe life into this wind-kissed world together!

[h1]See you in the skies![/h1]

Warm regards,
Cherry,
Pink Sakura Studios

notes.title: Update 1.6.0 Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]📢 Update 1.6.0 Patch Notes - Closed Beta Exclusive![/b][/h1]

[h2]Hello, My Valued Community![/h2]

I am thrilled to announce the latest update for our beloved game, available exclusively to our dedicated Closed Beta community! Your relentless feedback and support have been instrumental in shaping the future of our game, and I couldn't be more excited to unveil the improvements and additions I've made.

[h2]What's New in Update 1.6.0:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Two New Thrilling Levels: Prepare yourselves for fresh challenges! I've added two brand-new levels to put your skills to the ultimate test. Explore treacherous landscapes and conquer new obstacles that will push your gaming prowess to its limits![/b]

[*] Community Bug Fixes: I have been diligently combing through your bug reports. Say goodbye to those pesky issues you've encountered, as I've squashed them with the utmost precision. Your gameplay experience will now be smoother than ever before.

[*] [b]Wind Refill Power-Up: A new feature awaits you - the Wind Refill Power-Up! Harness the power of this ability to replenish your wind mid-air, enabling you to perform even more daring maneuvers. Use it wisely and conquer the skies like never before!
[/b]
[*] Balancing Bonanza: Your valuable feedback helped us identify areas for improvement in certain levels. I've revisited and fine-tuned the difficulty of these stages to provide a more balanced and enjoyable experience. Sharpen your skills and tackle those challenges head-on!

[*] [b]Performance Boost: I've worked tirelessly to optimize the game's performance. Now, you can expect:
    [list]
[*] smoother framerates
[*] reduced loading times
[*] and an overall enhanced gameplay experience [/list]
Immerse yourself fully in the breathtaking world I've crafted for you![/b]

[/list]
[h3]Please note that this update is exclusively available to our esteemed Closed Beta community. I value your dedication and commitment to helping me shape the game, and I can't wait to hear your thoughts on these exciting additions and improvements.[/h3]

[h2]How to Access the Closed Beta:[/h2]

If you're already a part of our Closed Beta, you'll automatically receive the update when launching the steam client. If you aren't part of the Closed Beta but wish to join and experience the new features firsthand, keep an eye out for announcements on how to participate, or send a direct e-mail to “[u]contact.pink.sakura.studios@gmail.com[/u]”.

[b]Once again, a heartfelt thank you to all our Closed Beta participants for making this possible. Your passion and enthusiasm continue to fuel our development efforts. Stay tuned for more thrilling updates and surprises as I journey together towards the full release![/b]

[h1]See you in the skies![/h1]

The Pink Sakura Studios Team (or more like one person, lmao)

notes.title: Playtests are now avalaible for sign ups!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Steam community![/h1]

[h3][b]I have some exciting news to share with you today.
The playtest version of my game is now available for you to try out! I'm thrilled to be able to offer you a sneak peek of what's to come, and I hope you enjoy it as much as I do.[/b]

The playtest version is about the same size as my planned free demo, so I'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback. Your constructive criticism will help me improve the game and make it even better for everyone.

[b]I'm also happy to announce that you can now apply for the playtests directly from the game's store page. I encourage you to sign up and join me in shaping the future of this game.[/b]

Thank you for your continued support, and I look forward to hearing your feedback![/h3]
